Package
Description
io.github.jabrena.juno.javax.net.ssl
Board-side implementations of javax.net.ssl: an SSLContext that carries the trust anchors of a java.net.http client.
io.github.jabrena.juno.jdk.net.http
Board-side implementations of java.net.http: the JDK's HTTP client syntax on the board.
  • Classes in io.github.jabrena.juno.javax.net.ssl used by io.github.jabrena.juno.javax.net.ssl
    Class
    Description
    KeyManager
    The board-side javax.net.ssl.KeyManager, only as the type of SSLContext.init(KeyManager[], TrustManager[], SecureRandom)'s first parameter: client certificates are not supported, so a program passes null.
    SSLContext
    The board-side javax.net.ssl.SSLContext: the trust a java.net.http client checks servers against, given with HttpClient.newBuilder().sslContext(context).
    TrustManager
    The board-side javax.net.ssl.TrustManager: what a TrustManagerFactory hands to an SSLContext.
    TrustManagerFactory
    The board-side javax.net.ssl.TrustManagerFactory: turns a KeyStore of trusted certificates into the TrustManager an SSLContext takes.
